title: calamagrostis × maritima
intro: Calamagrostis × maritima, commonly known as Purple Sea Grass or Sea Fennel, is a hybrid plant species that is native to coastal areas of Europe and Asia. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion due to its high content of antioxidants and polyphenols. The therapeutic actions of Calamagrostis × maritima include its use as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
